note: September 2026 — written by hand because the month actually had news. Delete the handwritten flag after this send so October generates itself again.
subject: 🐸 Big month at the pond (and something for you)
heading: From the pond this month
body_html:
Hello. This is usually a quiet note, but September arrives with actual news, so just this once it is a slightly longer one.

The frogs have moved in. There is a whole new range — the Comfort & Chaos collection. One small green frog living through seven very relatable moods: wrapped in a blanket, battery at 3%, five tabs open and none responding. Tees, mugs, a water bottle, a wall print. The typographic pieces have not gone anywhere; the shop just has two doors now.

The Pond Guides are free. All of them. The 23 plain-English guides — one per neurotype, written to be handed to a relative, a partner, a manager — used to cost money. Now they cost nothing: no email address, no catch. Download, print, pass on.

And the Bespoke Planner exists. Every planner you have ever bought was designed for somebody else’s brain. This one asks nine questions and gets built for yours — emailed as a printable PDF, usually within a couple of hours. £10.

Yours, because you signed up: the code POND10 takes 10% off your first order — type it into the promotion-code box at checkout. That was always the promise for subscribers, and now the till understands it.

That's the lot. Go gently.
